question: The Similipal Biosphere Reserve that promotes conservation of biodiversity and alternative livelihood is located in:
solution:
Correct answer is __**Odisha.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• The 5,569-square kilometre **Similipal Biosphere Reserve** is Odisha's first such reserve and was notified on May 20, 1996.
 
• Simlipal bio-reserve is located in the district of Mayurbhanj in **Odisha state**.
 
• Similipal Biosphere Reserve deliberates to **encourage**** the **conservation of biodiversity and as well to promote alternate livelihood for man and preserve cultural values.
 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fc49355dfe09326074cd18d39fabdfb1d5059dfd5c0be8a124c413ea4166b098.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The total count of Conservation reserves in Rajasthan is **14**.
 
• The **Ranthambore National Park** is one of the largest and principal national parks in the country.
 
• **Hastinapur Wildlife Sanctuary** is a secured area in the Gangetic plains of **Uttar Pradesh, India.**
 
• **Noradehi** is the largest of all the wildlife sanctuaries in** Madhya Pradesh.****​ **
